alyssa: Planning ZephyrCorp dedicated bring-up. Proposed stepped load: 5min steps at 10/30/60/90/110% of baseline. Need quota window, slot map, KMS, and rollback criteria. Target Mon 2026-04-06 14:00 PT.

samir: ok. Autoscale: scale-up 30s, scale-down 900s. Rollback if p99>1.5s for 2 steps or errors >=0.5% in any step. Fallback to lite-model if GPU>85%.

marta: CS note: renewal end-May, need clean pass by 4/10. We'll collect 3 priority prompts for regression checks.

ops-bot: slot-mapper: reserving pool-eu-west slots 81-84. Quota template: quota=92%, burst=25%, window=60s. KMS ticket #KMS-412 created.

kevin-cs: I'll draft stakeholder one-pager and rollback play. Please confirm loadgen command so ops can run external dry-run.

alyssa: suggested loadgen:
`./loadgen --target https://dedicated.zephyr/engage --steps 300,900,1800,2700,3300 --step-duration 300 --concurrency 40`

samir: looks good. Action items: samir (policy + monitoring hooks), ops-bot (confirm KMS & slot mapping), kevin-cs (one-pager). Go/no-go sync at 13:30 PT day-of.
